correctness.rationale: Proof supplies a coherent D_n-equivariant barycentric SDR of n tetrahedra to a 2n-triangle surface, unique outer edges make glueing exact, and oriented manifold links plus Euler zero identify torus. A free cyclic covering yields one-vertex torus, and induced orientation-preserving involution has four fixed points, giving sphere quotient by surface classification. Complete exact finite checks at n=9..64 and dihedral Lefschetz traces support the local proof. The finite checks are not substituted for the all-n proof.

value.rationale: Full natural graph-automorphism quotient has an unexpectedly distinct topological type, S2 rather than the underlying torus. The explicit all-n equivariant SDR is exactly what permits the quotient inference, and the rank-two reflection-sign homology representation is structural information not given by nonequivariant torus homotopy alone.
